secrets.name: The Drum Passage
secrets.text: A stone ring behind the dome, one person wide. Through the slits the storm is close enough to touch, and it smells of hot pennies. Someone has left a chair at every window.

meta.label: The Thunder Atrium
meta.blurb: A storm has got into the dome and cannot find its way out. It grumbles over the reading desks. Someone has put up a lightning rod, which seems to satisfy everyone.
